scope.series: 데브코스 회고 1-3편 - 자바 심화, 객체지향, 인터페이스

multi_source_note: Three retrospective posts are mined together; locators carry an `s` index into the source list and update candidates override the source per item.

overlap_analysis.finding: These are course retrospectives written by the author, so most of what they restate - encapsulation, inheritance, abstraction, polymorphism, the interface, the anonymous class, the lambda - is already applied from the Java lectures and books. What is new is the design vocabulary the course used around them: the framework-independence standard and the abstraction that supplies it, four of the five design rules, and the way a dependency is progressively loosened until it comes from outside.
overlap_analysis.disposition: Seventeen applied concepts gain evidence or edges. Seventeen new concepts, chiefly filling out the principle namespace which held only three of the five rules.

review_flag_policy.conflict: The candidate's evidence lies in the same domain as an applied concept, so U3 must confirm it relates rather than restates. Every update candidate carries this flag by construction.
review_flag_policy.low-confidence: The cited span carries three or fewer prose lines.
review_flag_policy.provenance-warning: The evidence span is a blockquote rather than plain prose.
review_flag_policy.sampling_note: Every flagged candidate must be fully sampled at U3.

update_authoring_note.statement: All seventeen update candidates were generated mechanically from the applied notes, so every approved locator, alias, tag, path and edge is carried forward verbatim and only the new locator and edges are appended.
update_authoring_note.tooling: .omx/tmp/lane/build-updates.mjs reads each applied note's frontmatter and emits the candidate; the diff against the staged document is checked before signing.

uncited_substantive_prose.detail: The personal diary opening each post - moving flats, how the week felt - the links to the author's own blog and to others', the captions above each code listing and diagram, and the passages that narrate the author working out a conclusion that the cited span then states. The DIP restatement in 003 L107-L112 is left uncited because the same rule is cited from 002, where it is stated once.

exclusions_and_coverage.coverage_statement: Every heading scope carrying prose contributes at least one cited locator, except 001's JAVA 개발환경 and IDE sections, which carry only the blog link and the diary line.

budget_accounting.ceilings_unchanged: B1 60000 bytes, B2 70 heading scopes, B3 55 positive prose scopes, B4 360 prose lines, B5 40 accepted candidates. None is raised.

finalization_status.forbidden: This manifest authorizes nothing. It is the input to `propose --batch`; U3 signature and apply are separate gates.

forward_reference_note: No candidate references a concept outside this batch and the applied set.

duplicate_avoided_note.statement: Four candidates were withdrawn after the collision report showed the concept already applied. The evidence they carried became a locator on the incumbent instead.
duplicate_avoided_note.rule: Check the collision report before signing. Apply succeeds with collisions present; only verify fails.

candidates.title: String constant pool

candidates.title: java.lang.Object
candidates.concept_granularity: single root every class inherits from when it names no other parent, which is why every class is a descendant of Object

candidates.title: equals()와 hashCode()
candidates.concept_granularity: single pair that must be overridden together - equals decides value equality by a standard the developer sets rather than by reference, and hash-based collections need both to work

candidates.title: 캡슐화

candidates.title: 다형성
candidates.concept_granularity: single object-oriented design property

candidates.title: 개방-폐쇄 원칙
candidates.concept_granularity: single principle that a piece of software should admit extension without being modified, which polymorphism is the mechanism for and which dependency injection delivers in practice - the implementing class is swapped in configuration while the code using it is never touched

candidates.title: 의존 역전 원칙
candidates.concept_granularity: single principle of the five that a higher-level module must not depend on a lower-level one, both depending on an abstraction instead - so a field typed to a concrete class is what makes change expensive, and typing it to an interface is what makes either side replaceable

candidates.title: 마이크로 서비스 아키텍처
candidates.concept_granularity: single arrangement splitting one application into small services that each do one business function and talk to each other over defined interfaces - whose characteristic difficulties are answered by collecting the scattered logs into one searchable place, and by giving up distributed transactions in favour of compensating actions, a composite service, or a use case that verifies the result

candidates.title: 모놀리식 아키텍처
candidates.concept_granularity: single arrangement with everything in one project and one process, so meeting demand on any part of it means scaling all of it, usually by making the machine bigger - which is loosened within the pattern by splitting into modules, and whose slow deployment is worked around by releasing without downtime, by parallel environments, by a gradual rollout or by replacing instances one at a time

candidates.title: 인터페이스
candidates.concept_granularity: single object-oriented type-declaration construct, including its Java 8 default/static and Java 9 private member extensions

candidates.concept_granularity: single object-oriented class-abstraction mechanism

candidates.title: 익명 클래스
candidates.concept_granularity: single class written as a constructor call followed by a body, which overrides what it needs on the spot and is used where the type will not be reused - the way an abstract class or interface gets instantiated without a named subclass

candidates.title: 람다 인터페이스
candidates.concept_granularity: single interface carrying exactly one method, which is what lets an anonymous object be shortened into a lambda expression - a JDK 8 addition and part of what modern Java means, especially alongside the Stream API

candidates.title: 제어의 역전
candidates.concept_granularity: single principle that the flow of control belongs outside the code rather than in it - which is an idea and not a mechanism, dependency injection being one way of realising it; what it buys is that an object no longer decides what it is made of, so changing that decision no longer means changing the object

candidates.title: POJO
aliases: 특정 기술에 종속되지 않는 순수한 객체
candidates.concept_granularity: single name given to an ordinary java object precisely because it needed one - the enterprise component model of the time had an impressive name and putting domain logic in a plain object did not, so the plain object was named; inheriting a class or implementing an interface does not disqualify it, only depending on a particular framework or environment does

candidates.title: PSA
candidates.concept_granularity: single answer to how an object can use a technology without depending on it - a standard interface is defined and the implementations become interchangeable behind it, so the code names the abstraction and the particular library underneath can be replaced without touching it

candidates.title: 팩토리 메서드 패턴
candidates.concept_granularity: single pattern hiding how an instance is built and returning only the finished object, so the caller asks a factory for it instead of running new itself

candidates.title: Gradle의 task
candidates.concept_granularity: single unit the build tool executes - declared in the build script, with the common ones supplied by the application plugin rather than written by hand, the script itself being written in the older scripting language even as the newer one gains ground

candidates.title: String, StringBuffer, StringBuilder 중 무엇을 쓸까
candidates.concept_granularity: single decision among the three string types, made on two axes - how much concatenation happens and whether more than one thread is involved - which in practice means the immutable one when there is little of it, the synchronized builder under several threads, and the unsynchronized builder only when synchronization is provably unnecessary; and the observation that server code is normally multi-threaded, so the first two are the usual answers

candidates.title: 동일성과 동등성
candidates.concept_granularity: single distinction between two senses of sameness - whether two names refer to one and the same object, which the reference comparison answers, and whether two objects carry the same information, which only a method can answer; and the pairing of the hash and the equality check in hash-based collections, where matching hashes alone do not make two objects equal but a false equality check settles it

candidates.title: 좋은 객체와 나쁜 객체
candidates.concept_granularity: single standard an object is judged by - that it holds one role, does what that role is responsible for, and works with others to get the rest done - against which the bad one is recognisable by holding several roles, by carrying state and behaviour its name does not suggest, or by not working at all

candidates.title: 상속에 관한 오해
candidates.concept_granularity: single misuse of the mechanism - reaching for it whenever several classes happen to share code, rather than only when one genuinely is a more specific kind of the other, which is the relation it exists to express

candidates.title: 추상체를 만드는 세 가지 방법
candidates.concept_granularity: single scale of how abstract the parent is made - both sides fully implemented and grouped only by meaning, the parent defining some behaviour and leaving the rest, or the parent defining nothing at all and being purely a specification

candidates.title: SOLID 원칙
candidates.concept_granularity: single set of five rules answering whether a design is good, which comes down to two questions - how the work was divided among objects and how those objects were connected to each other

candidates.title: 단일 책임 원칙
candidates.concept_granularity: single rule that an object should have exactly one reason to change, which is the same as saying it carries exactly one responsibility - so a class that would need editing for two unrelated reasons is two classes

candidates.title: 리스코프 치환 원칙
candidates.concept_granularity: single rule that anywhere the general type is expected, any specific one must work without the caller noticing - which follows for free when the parent really is the more abstract thing, and is broken exactly when inheritance was used to share code between classes that are not kinds of one another

candidates.title: 인터페이스 분리 원칙
candidates.concept_granularity: single rule that a specification should be split until each one carries only what some caller actually needs, so that handing out one capability does not hand out the others alongside it

candidates.title: 어댑터와 default 메서드
candidates.concept_granularity: single problem the defaulted method was introduced to solve - a specification demands every one of its methods be written even when the implementer wants one, which used to be worked around by an intermediate class supplying empty bodies, itself unusable whenever the implementer already extends something else; a body on the specification removes the need for that class entirely, and lets a specification gain a method without breaking what already implements it

candidates.title: 메서드 레퍼런스
candidates.concept_granularity: single shorthand for the case where a lambda does nothing but pass its argument through to one method - naming that method directly instead, which besides being shorter states that the value is not touched on the way

candidates.title: 동작 자체를 호스트 코드로 미루기
candidates.concept_granularity: single pattern that falls out of taking a function as a parameter - what to do is written where the call is made rather than where the work happens, so the same implementation serves different behaviours without being edited; the same move as taking a dependency from outside, applied to behaviour instead of to an object
